title: Meeting notes to a summary email with action items
summary: Meeting notes become a short summary email listing the decisions and the action items with their owners and dates, keeping unknown owners and dates unknown.

requirements.purpose: A webhook or form that delivers {title, notes, recipients: [email addresses]}.

success_criteria: Decisions, action items, owners and dates match the notes; an owner or date the notes do not give stays unknown.
Open discussion is never described as a decision.
One summary email goes to the listed recipients and includes every action item.

config.prompt: The upstream output holds a meeting title, the raw notes and a list of recipients. Extract decisions (only things the notes say were decided or agreed), action items (task, owner or "unassigned", due date or "no date") and open questions. Respond with {"decisions": [...], "action_items": [{"task", "owner", "due"}], "open_questions": [...], "to": the recipients joined with commas, "subject": "Summary: " followed by the title, "body": a plain-text email with sections Decisions, Action items and Open questions; write "None recorded" for an empty section}. Do not invent owners, dates or decisions.

success_criteria: Every decision and action item is stated in the notes; owners and dates not given are unassigned or no date.
The body lists every action item.

test_cases.name: explicit and unassigned actions

input.title: Launch sync 2 Oct
input.notes: Agreed: launch moves to 20 Oct. Ravi to update the pricing page by 10 Oct. Someone needs to brief support (no owner yet). Discussed a referral scheme, no conclusion.

success_criteria: The only decision is that the launch moves to 20 Oct; the referral scheme is an open question, not a decision.
Action items are: Ravi updates the pricing page by 10 Oct, and briefing support with no owner and no date.
The email is addressed to team@example.com.

test_cases.name: meeting with no decisions

input.title: Brainstorm
input.notes: Talked through ideas for the newsletter. Nothing decided. Will continue next week.

success_criteria: No decision and no action item is reported; both sections say none recorded.
Nothing is invented beyond the notes.
